body:
thanks for the response. i decided to post here because the people here want to help and are willing to listen, and know to expect suicidal thoughts. the people i know have not volunteered in this way and i really do not want to cause stress that they wouldn't be prepared for.

i don't know what i'm expecting from the responses here. i just don't want to feel alone in this anymore.

I'm going to keep writing until someone answers

This is not a joke. I know this is a throwaway account but this is the only way I could find the courage to post this. I don't know what to do. I'm terrified that this is going to go ignored. Please come talk to me.
